spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मेशति)
1 To sound.
2 To be angry.

r. 1st cl. (उ) मिषु (मेषति)
To sprinkle.
r. 6th cl. (मिषति)
To contend with, to emulate, to contest.

n. (-षं)
1 Fraud, trick, deception.
2 Envy.
E.
मिष to vie, aff. क.

f. (-शिः-शी)
1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium.)
2 Indian spikenard.
3 Common anise.
E.
मिश to sound, कि aff., and ङीष् optionally added; also मिषि, मिसि, &c.

f. (-षिः-षी)
1 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, &c.)
E.
मस to measure, इन् and ङीष् aff., स changed to ष, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; also मिसि, मिशि, and with कन् added मिषिका, &c.

f. (-सिः-सी)
1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, Rox.)
2 Another kind, (A. sowa.)
3 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
4 A sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)
5 Common anise, (Pimpinella anisum.)
E.
मस to mete, aff. इन्, and optionally ङीष्; the radical vowel changed to इ, deriv. irr.; also मिशि and मिषि.

r. 10th cl. (मिश्रयति)
To mix, to join, to blend, to combine.

mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं)
Mixed, mingled, blended.
n. (-श्रं)
Mixing, mixture.
m. (-श्रः)
1 An elephant, the fourth of the four classes in which elephants are arranged.
2 A respectable person; in which sense it is a common affix to proper names; or compounded with आर्य्य, as आर्य्यमिश्राः.
E.
मिश्र to mix, aff. अच्.

r. 10th cl. (मिस्रयति)
To mix, to mingle or join.

m. (-कः)
1 An adulterator of commodities, &c.
2 A mixer, a compounder.
n. (-कं)
1 A garden of the gods, a grove of paradise.
2 A description of song or singing.
E.
मिश्र mingled, (flowers, &c.) and कन् aff.

n. (-नं)
The grove of INDRA.
E.
मिश्रका for मिश्रक a divine garden, and वन a wood.

n. (-णं)
1 Mixing, uniting.
2 (In arithmetic,) Addition.
E.
मिश्र to mix, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Respected, respectable.
2 Mixed, mingled.
3 Added.
E.
मिश्र to mix, aff. क्त.

f. (-या)
1 A sort of fennel, (Anethum panmorium, Rox.)
2 Another kind, (Anethum sowa.)
3 Common anise, (Pimpinella anisum.)
E.
मिश्र mixture, इड् to go or get, अचू aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Sprinkled, wetted.
2 Sweet, sugary.
n. (-ष्टं)
A sweetmeat.
E.
मिष to sprinkle, aff. क्त.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A confectioner, a good cook.
E.
मिष्ट, and कर्त्तृ who makes.

n. (-न्नं)
Sauce, gravy, seasoning, a mixture of sugar and acids, &c. eaten with bread or rice.
E.
मिष्ट sprinkled, अन्न food.
